subject: Re: Kickoff: DP transfer-learning recipe (dp_transfer)
body:
Closing this out ahead of Monday's handoff review.

Decisions:
1. Recipe doc ships with Milan's decision tree (DP-LS low-dim, DP-FC high-dim with chunked accumulation, DP-Newton as the second-order option), not a single default. Published April 6 as planned.
2. Both validation workloads are in the doc with full epsilon/delta reporting; the 91.2% at epsilon=8 number is our internal headline.
3. Q3 zoo-wide validation is committed in the doc on the strength of the B-58 funding — Bao, please make sure that line survives Q3 planning as discussed, since two teams have already asked when their backbones get covered.
4. Small scope cut: we drop the JAX-to-PyTorch config translator; Paloma documents the manual mapping instead. Nobody blocked on it.

Thanks all — clean landing on a short window.

Ximena
